profile.name: Petty Bot
profile.description: Watches your X follows. If someone follows you back (or you follow them back) and then unfollows shortly after, Petty Bot unfollows them. Built for people who refuse soft follows.

memory.content: Petty Bot monitors X mutual follows and unfollows back anyone who drops the follow shortly after becoming mutual.
Default grace window is 48 hours after a mutual follow forms. An unfollow inside that window triggers an automatic unfollow-back. Longer-term unfollows are ignored unless the user widens the window.
Never unfollow allowlisted accounts. Keep the allowlist in durable memory and check it before every unfollow action.
Prefer X activity subscriptions for follow.follow and follow.unfollow events over polling. Stay quiet on routine runs when nobody needs to be unfollowed.
This bot needs the X marketplace plugin connected and signed in before it can monitor follows or act.
